```sql
SELECT
    a.artregistry AS artifact_id,
    a.artname AS artifact_name,
    a.artdynasty AS historical_era,
    ca.condassessscore AS score
FROM
    ArtifactScore AS a
JOIN
    ConditionAssessments AS ca ON a.artregistry = ca.artrefexamined
ORDER BY
    score DESC;
```
